title: Party roles simplificados
status: Propuestas para revisión; las versiones canónicas no se han reemplazado.
style: Silueta directa, contorno oscuro grueso, rellenos amplios azul hielo, pergamino y latón, detalle reducido para lectura a 24 px.

tank.prompt:
Create one isolated Vandrheim RPG party-role UI icon. Visual family: simple bold illustrated icon, large instantly readable silhouette, thick clean charcoal outline, broad solid fills, only 2 or 3 large color regions, restrained flat bevel highlights, slate/ice blue + parchment cream + warm brass gold. No metal scratches, no photorealism, no ornate filigree, no runic engraving, no micro-details, no text or letters. The icon must remain unmistakable when displayed at 24 pixels. Center it on a square transparent canvas with comfortable padding. Preserve a clean 2D game-icon look. Transparent background, PNG with true alpha.

Reference 1 is the current Tank icon; use it only to identify the shield concept and the Vandrheim palette, then simplify it drastically. Design a single broad, sturdy heater shield facing forward. Use a large slate-blue shield face, one thick warm-gold rim, and one simple centered cream boss plate. The shield silhouette itself must dominate and read as protection immediately. No cross, no swords, no extra symbols, no texture.
